durtlang.name: Durtlang
durtlang.about:
Durtlang sits on the hilltop on the northern side of Aizawl and is the highest point in the city, at an elevation of 1,384 metres. Once a separate village with its own chief, it was absorbed into the growing city along with Chaltlang by the early 1960s. In 1924 a theological school moved to the Durtlang hilltop, and the hill has been a church and medical centre for the region ever since. The municipal ward also covers Durtlang North, Durtlang Leitan, Selesih, Zuangtui and Muanna Veng.

Like most of Aizawl, homes here are built along steep slopes, often as multi-storey buildings where a family's floor may be above or below the road. Bawngkawn and Chaltlang are the nearest neighbours on the way into the city, so tutors living in that belt are the easiest match. Share the house name, the floor and a nearby landmark for the first visit. Because the road climbs to the highest part of the ridge, allow extra time in heavy rain, and consider online classes for specialist subjects. chaltlang.name: Chaltlang
chaltlang.about:
Chaltlang was a village on the edge of early Aizawl that became part of the expanding city by the early 1960s. Today it forms a municipal ward with Chaltlang Lily Veng, Bawngkawn and Bawngkawn South, and the district's zonal list groups it with Laipuitlang and Bawngkawn West. The academic wing of the state Directorate of School Education has been based at Chaltlang since it was set up, so the locality has long been connected with school education in Mizoram.

Homes are mostly multi-storey buildings on the hillside, typical of Aizawl, with families living on different levels reached by stairs from the road. For a home tutor, that means giving a clear landmark and floor number before the first class. Bawngkawn, Durtlang and Ramhlun are close neighbours, which gives families a reasonable pool of nearby tutors. Roads into the city centre are the main route for everyone, so agree a regular weekday slot and keep a little margin for traffic and for heavy rain between April and October. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

bawngkawn.name: Bawngkawn
bawngkawn.about:
Bawngkawn is a residential locality of Aizawl, in the same municipal ward as Chaltlang and Chaltlang Lily Veng, with Bawngkawn South and Bawngkawn West as its parts. Geologists have studied the rock layers exposed between Bawngkawn and Durtlang, which shows how the two sit along the same stretch of hills. The state co-operative bank runs a branch here, and Ramhlun and Zemabawk are other nearby groups of localities.

For families, Bawngkawn's position is useful: tutors living in Durtlang, Chaltlang, Ramhlun or Zemabawk can usually reach it without crossing the whole city. Housing is mainly multi-storey buildings on the slopes, so describe the building and the floor when you book a demo, and mention whether the tutor should come to the road-level entrance or a lower one. Road transport is the only way around Aizawl, and busy junctions get crowded at office hours, so a fixed slot outside the evening rush works well. In heavy rain allow extra time. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

ramhlun.name: Ramhlun
ramhlun.about:
Ramhlun is a group of residential localities in Aizawl made up of Ramhlun North, Ramhlun Venglai, Ramhlun Vengthar, Ramhlun Sports Complex and Ramhlun South. The municipal ward lists also place Laipuitlang alongside Ramhlun, while Ramthar North, Ramthar and Aizawl Venglai sit in the next ward. The district administration groups the Ramhlun localities and Ramthar North together in one zone.

Laipuitlang is listed with Ramhlun in the municipal wards and with Chaltlang in the district zones, so it is easy for tutors living in Chaltlang, Bawngkawn, Chanmari or Zarkawt to take on a home here. Most families live in multi-storey buildings stepped along the hillside, so a tutor may need to use stairs from the road; share the building name, floor and a phone number for the first visit. Parking is easier on a two-wheeler than in a car on narrow hill roads. Plan around the evening rush on the roads to the centre, and choose online classes when the right subject specialist lives elsewhere. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

zemabawk.name: Zemabawk
zemabawk.about:
Zemabawk is a group of localities in Aizawl that includes Zemabawk North, South, East and West, with Falkland and Thuampui in the same municipal ward. The district's zonal list also groups Zuangtui and Muanna Veng with it, and Zuangtui is home to one of the state's two industrial estates. Falkland has state rental housing built under a national urban housing scheme, and a regional paramedical and nursing institute is located in Zemabawk.

For home tuition, Zemabawk mixes residential lanes with institutional and industrial land nearby, so families should give the tutor a precise landmark and the building or housing block name. Government rental blocks and larger buildings may keep a record of visitors, while smaller houses allow direct arrival at the door. Tutors living in Zemabawk, Thuampui or Bawngkawn are the easiest match for regular weekday classes. Road travel is the only option across the city, so keep a fixed slot outside peak hours and allow extra time in heavy rain. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

chanmari.name: Chanmari
chanmari.about:
Chanmari is a central Aizawl locality that shares a municipal ward with Electric Veng and Zarkawt, while Chanmari West forms a separate ward with Edenthar and Hunthar. The district administration places it in the central zone along with Aizawl Venglai, Electric Veng, Zarkawt, Dawrpui, Saron Veng, Chhinga Veng, Armed Veng and Chite. A commerce and arts college has stood in Chanmari since 1980, and the locality also gives its name to one of the city's football clubs.

Being central, Chanmari has a college and other institutions close to homes, and housing is mostly multi-storey buildings on the slopes, as across Aizawl. Tutors living in Zarkawt, Dawrpui, Ramhlun or Electric Veng can usually reach it without a long ride. Central roads are busy through the day, so a fixed slot outside the evening rush helps, and a two-wheeler is easier to park than a car. Share the building name, the floor and a landmark, and use online sessions for specialist subjects when the tutor lives across the city. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

zarkawt.name: Zarkawt
zarkawt.about:
Zarkawt lies in the centre of Aizawl and includes McDonald Hill, where the state museum moved to a new building in 1990 and where the Directorate of School Education and the Department of Higher and Technical Education have their offices. The first high school in the Mizo hills opened at Zarkawt in February 1944, so the locality has been tied to education for a long time. It shares a municipal ward with Chanmari and Electric Veng.

With state government offices nearby, Zarkawt is a mixed central area where families live in multi-storey buildings close to the main roads. This makes it easy for tutors from Chanmari, Dawrpui, Khatla and Ramhlun to reach, though central roads are crowded at office hours. Fix class times that avoid the morning and evening rush, give the tutor a clear landmark and floor number, and keep a little margin in heavy rain. Online classes suit subjects where the right specialist lives on the far side of the city. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

dawrpui.name: Dawrpui
dawrpui.about:
Dawrpui Veng is a central Aizawl locality and the home of Bara Bazar, the city's main shopping centre. It forms a municipal ward with Saron Veng, Chhinga Veng and Tuithang Veng, and the district administration places it in the central zone with Chanmari, Zarkawt, Electric Veng and Armed Veng. Dawrpui Vengthar, a separate locality, sits in another ward with Vaivakawn and Kanan Veng.

Because the main market is here, Dawrpui has a dense mix of shops and homes, with families living in multi-storey buildings along the slopes above and below the busy roads. Tutors from Zarkawt, Chanmari, Khatla or Tuikual can usually reach it, but the market roads are crowded for much of the day. For a regular home class, pick a time outside shopping hours, give a precise landmark and floor number, and expect the tutor to walk the last part from a parking spot. Online lessons are a practical choice for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

tuikual.name: Tuikual
tuikual.about:
Tuikual is made up of Tuikual North and Tuikual South, and it forms a municipal ward with Dinthar. The district's zonal list groups it with Dawrpui Vengthar, Vaivakawn, Hunthar and Edenthar, so it sits in a belt of residential localities beside the central part of Aizawl. Dinthar also lends its name to one of the clubs in the state's football league.

Housing in Tuikual is the usual Aizawl pattern of multi-storey buildings on steep slopes, with deep valleys separating one locality from the next. In practice, that means the right tutor is often the one living on the same side of the valley, in Tuikual, Dinthar, Vaivakawn or Dawrpui Vengthar, rather than the one who looks closest on a map. Ask the tutor to confirm the route before the demo, share the building name and floor, and keep class times fixed. In heavy rain allow extra time, and use online classes for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

vaivakawn.name: Vaivakawn
vaivakawn.about:
Vaivakawn forms a municipal ward with Dawrpui Vengthar and Kanan Veng, and the district administration groups it with Tuikual, Dinthar, Hunthar and Edenthar. Kanan, Chawnpui, Zonuam and Luangmual form the next district zone, so Vaivakawn sits where these two groups of localities meet.

For families, Vaivakawn's position means tutors from both the central localities and the Luangmual side can come here. Homes are mostly multi-storey buildings built into the hillside, so a tutor may arrive at the road level and take stairs to the flat; tell the tutor which entrance to use. Busy junctions get crowded at office hours, so agree a weekday slot outside the evening rush, and keep a margin in heavy rain between April and October. Online classes are a good fallback when the right subject specialist lives across the city. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

luangmual.name: Luangmual
luangmual.about:
Luangmual is a residential locality of Aizawl in a municipal ward with Chawlhhmun, Tanhril, Sakawrtuichhun, Rangvamual and Phunchawng. The district's zonal list places it with Kanaan, Chawnpui, Zotlang, Zonuam and Ainawn Veng. Its football club, founded in 1955, is one of the older clubs in the city and has played in the state league.

Luangmual shares its ward with Tanhril and the outer localities, though housing is still mostly multi-storey buildings on the slopes, as in the rest of Aizawl. Tutors living in Chawnpui, Zonuam, Vaivakawn or Tanhril are the most practical match for regular classes. Share the house or building name, the floor and a landmark, and agree how the tutor should park. In heavy rain allow extra time on hill roads, and choose online sessions when a specialist subject teacher lives on the far side of the city. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

tanhril.name: Tanhril
tanhril.about:
Tanhril lies on the outskirts of Aizawl, in a municipal ward with Luangmual, Chawlhhmun, Sakawrtuichhun, Rangvamual and Phunchawng. It is known as the home of the permanent campus of the state's central university, set on a large area of forested hillside, and an engineering institute also has hostel blocks here. The district's zonal list groups it with Rangvamual, Phunchawng, Sakawrtuichhun, Central Jail Veng and Tuivamit.

With a large campus nearby, Tanhril has a mix of institutional land and family homes. Because it is on the edge of the city, tutors from Luangmual, Chawnpui and Zonuam are the nearest, and a tutor coming from the centre needs a longer ride. Campus housing may have its own rules for visitors, so check how a tutor is admitted before the demo. Fix a regular slot, allow extra time in heavy rain, and consider online classes for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

khatla.name: Khatla
khatla.about:
Khatla is a residential part of Aizawl that forms a municipal ward with Khatla South and Mission Venglang, while Khatla East sits in the next ward with Bungkawn, Bungkawn Vengthar, Maubawk, Lawipu and Nursery Veng. The district administration groups all of these localities together in one zone, so families looking for a nearby tutor can treat them as one cluster.

Homes are mostly multi-storey buildings set into the slopes, as in the rest of Aizawl, so tutors often walk up or down steps from the road; share the building name, the floor and a landmark. Tutors living in Khatla, Bungkawn, Maubawk or Lawipu can usually keep a regular weekday timetable without a long ride. Roads towards the centre are busy at office hours, so evening classes start on time when the tutor lives in the same cluster. In heavy rain allow extra time, and use online classes for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

mission-veng.name: Mission Veng and Mission Vengthlang
mission-veng.about:
Mission Veng is an old Aizawl locality that is home to the headquarters of the state's largest church body, and Mission Vengthlang is where a theological college was first located. The municipal ward also covers Salem Veng, Dam Veng, Venghnuai, Thakthing Veng and ITI Veng, and the district's zonal list groups Mission Veng and Mission Vengthlang with Salem Veng, Dam Veng, Venghnuai, Tuikhuahtlang and Model Veng. The city's large football stadium stands at Mualpui in Salem Veng.

Church offices, institutions and homes sit side by side here, and families live mostly in multi-storey buildings built along the slopes. Tutors from Salem Veng, Venghnuai, Thakthing or Kulikawn can usually reach these localities without crossing the city. On match days roads around the stadium get crowded, so avoid those hours for classes. Share the building name, the floor and a clear landmark for the first visit, keep a little margin in heavy rain, and use online sessions when the right subject specialist lives further away. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

bethlehem.name: Bethlehem and Bethlehem Vengthlang
bethlehem.about:
Bethlehem Veng and Bethlehem Vengthlang form a municipal ward with College Veng in Aizawl, and the next ward covers Venghlui, Republic Veng, Upper Republic and Republic Vengthlang. The district's zonal list groups Bethlehem, Bethlehem Vengthlang, College Veng, Venghlui, Upper Republic, Republic, Republic Veng and ITI together. A national research centre for bamboo and rattan opened at Bethlehem Vengthlang in November 2004.

These are mainly residential localities with homes in multi-storey buildings on the hillside, so a tutor usually needs the building name, floor and a nearby landmark to find the right door. Republic, Venghlui and College Veng are the nearest places to find a home tutor, and a tutor living in the same cluster can keep a regular weekday timetable easily. Roads to the centre get busy at office hours, so pick a slot outside the rush. In heavy rain allow extra time, and consider online classes for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

kulikawn.name: Kulikawn
kulikawn.about:
Kulikawn is an Aizawl locality that forms a municipal ward with Tlangnuam, Tlangnuam Vengthar, Saikhamakawn, Melthum and Hlimen. The district's zonal list groups the same localities with Thakthing. Kulikawn also gives its name to one of the clubs that have played in the state football league.

Housing follows the Aizawl pattern of multi-storey buildings on steep slopes, with localities separated by valleys, so the most practical tutor is usually one who lives in Kulikawn, Tlangnuam, Saikhamakawn or Thakthing rather than across the city. Tell the tutor which entrance to use and which floor the family lives on, and share a phone number for the first visit. Main roads towards the centre are busiest at office hours, so a fixed weekday slot outside that time works well. In heavy rain allow extra time, and use online classes for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

Durtlang, Chaltlang & Bawngkawn.fact: Durtlang is the highest point in Aizawl, at an elevation of 1,384 metres.
Nearby villages such as Chaltlang and Durtlang were absorbed into the expanding city by the early 1960s.
In 1924 a theological school was shifted from Aizawl to the hilltop at Durtlang, on the northern side of the city.
Municipal Ward 1 covers Selesih, Durtlang North, Durtlang, Durtlang Leitan, Zuangtui and Muanna Veng; Ward 2 covers Chaltlang, Bawngkawn, Bawngkawn South and Chaltlang Lily Veng.
The district's zonal list groups Thuampui, Muanna Veng, Zuangtui, Zemabawk (North, South, East and West) and Falkland in one zone.
Mizoram has two industrial estates, at Zuangtui and Kolasib.
Lengpui Airport, which serves Aizawl, became operational in 1998.

Chanmari, Zarkawt & Dawrpui.fact: Bara Bazar, the main shopping centre of Aizawl, is in the Dawrpui Veng locality.
The Mizoram State Museum moved to a new building at McDonald Hill on 14 July 1990.
The Directorate of School Education became a separate directorate in 1989 and is located at McDonald Hill, Zarkawt.
The first high school in Mizoram opened in February 1944 at Zarkawt.
Municipal Ward 5 covers Electric Veng, Chanmari and Zarkawt; Ward 9 covers Dawrpui Veng, Saron Veng, Chhinga Veng and Tuithang Veng.
The district's zonal list groups Aizawl Venglai, Electric Veng, Chanmari, Zarkawt, Chanmari West, Dawrpui, Saron Veng, Chhinga Veng, Tuithiang, Armed Veng, Armed Veng South and Chite in one zone.

Tuikual, Vaivakawn & Luangmual.fact: The permanent campus of the state's central university is at Tanhril on the outskirts of Aizawl and covers about 978 acres of forested hillside.
Municipal Ward 11 covers Luangmual, Chawlhhmun, Tanhril, Sakawrtuichhun, Rangvamual and Phunchawng.
Municipal Ward 12 covers Tuikual North, Tuikual South and Dinthar; Ward 13 covers Dawrpui Vengthar, Vaivakawn and Kanan Veng.
The district's zonal list groups Tuikual North, Tuikual South, Dinthar, Dawrpui Vengthar, Vaivakawn, Hunthar and Edenthar in one zone.
Luangmual Football Club was founded in Aizawl in 1955.
Sairang railway station, the terminus of the Bairabi-Sairang line serving Aizawl, was inaugurated on 13 September 2025.

Khatla, Mission Veng & Kulikawn.fact: The Mizoram Synod, the administrative body of the state's largest church, has its headquarters at Mission Veng, Aizawl.
A multi-purpose stadium at Mualpui, Salem Veng, had its foundation stone laid on 6 March 2010.
A national research centre for bamboo and rattan was inaugurated at Bethlehem Vengthlang on 29 November 2004.
Municipal Ward 14 covers Khatla, Khatla South and Mission Venglang; Ward 16 covers Bethlehem Veng, Bethlehem Vengthlang and College Veng.
Municipal Ward 19 covers Kulikawn, Tlangnuam, Saikhamakawn, Melthum, Hlimen and Tlangnuam Vengthar.
The district's zonal list groups Salem Veng, Dam Veng, Venghnuai, Tuikhuahtlang, Mission Veng, Mission Vengthlang and Model Veng in one zone.
